title: Issue summary: A server configured with the Suite B certificate flag through SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags() and with TLS 1.3…
description: A vulnerability in OpenSSL versions prior to 3.1.0 affects servers configured with the Suite B certificate flag and TLS 1.3 enabled. The server may read past the end of a fixed group list when processing a ClientHello message that contains no Suite B groups in its supported_groups and key_share extensions. This out-of-bounds read does not disclose memory to the client but may cause a denial of service on builds with sanitizers or hardened allocators due to process crashes.
